item.title: Version 1.0.29
item.description:
feat: 15-minute check-in window for long sessions

When you start a Focus or Unplug session of 4 hours or longer, the
in-session "▶ START 15-MIN CHECK-IN" button now appears on the
Mac Home screen during the session.  Tap it once to unlock the
phone for 15 minutes — the apps return, you grab a Citi Bike code
or download an app, and 15 minutes later the session locks back
down automatically.

One check-in per 20-hour rolling window per session.  Forever
sessions still don't qualify (uninterruptible by design).

Shorter sessions can opt-in via the toggle in ModesView.
